# boringNotch Custom 2.8.1
- Choose Dynamic Island or Notch for notchless displays. - Seasonal themes and matching icons, including a full-sized Christmas tree beside the Home calendar. - Sports favorites, compact scores, and score notifications. - Improved AI quota handling: low-usage warnings stay active and quota failures cannot turn into completion checks. - Native Liquid Glass on macOS 26 with lighter fallbacks on older macOS. - Fewer AI redraws and paused music timers for better efficiency.
Physical-notch and DisplayLink hardware validation and the full HUD restart regression remain pending. Developer-signed; not notarized.

# boringNotch Custom 2.8.0
- Shows a single Apple-style green completion check on one side of the notch. - Detects AI usage and rate limits, shows a red three-second alert, and clears abandoned working states automatically. - Adds an optional System tab with efficient, on-demand CPU, memory, storage, and thermal-pressure monitoring plus safe Mac controls. - Adds rounded rectangle, squircle, and capsule mirror shapes. - Introduces a new Liquid Glass app icon, native Apple Liquid Glass navigation and music controls, plus translucent Settings, Live, System, and Shelf surfaces. - Replaces the separate top buttons with a compact Apple-style segmented control and removes the stray pressed-symbol animation from music controls. - Keeps the HUD enabled across launches and rebuilds, automatically restarts its media-key interceptor after Accessibility approval, and uses a stable local signing identity so macOS keeps the permission grant. - Removes costly activation-policy switching when Settings opens and closes, making the custom Settings window significantly smoother. - Keeps Sparkle automatic updates on the public `graden-grech/boringNotch-custom` GitHub feed.
- Adds Codex and Claude Code activities with provider colors, Music/AI priority, dual-activity layouts, and four-second completion indicators. - Adds a location-aware weather tile that can live on Home or the Live page. - Restores native notch sizing when weather is on the Live page and keeps the calendar at its normal size. - Adds Live Activity controls, timers, download status, calendar alerts, and Apple-style privacy indicators. - Improves the HUD permission flow and keeps the original rounded notch shape. - Refines the AI completion checkmark and music waveform with a cleaner, Apple-like appearance. - Moves Sparkle updates to the public `graden-grech/boringNotch-custom` feed.
